location.Description:
The geographic location where the transfer config should reside.
Examples: US, EU, asia-northeast1. The default value is US.

name.Description: The generated id for the TagBinding. This is a string of the form: 'tagBindings/{full-resource-name}/{tag-value-name}'

parent.Description: The full resource name of the resource the TagValue is bound to. E.g. //cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/projects/123

tag_value.Description: The TagValue of the TagBinding. Must be of the form tagValues/456.
